up: Retrieve the distinct ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against target CHEMBL4105860 in Homo sapiens. Filter on target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4105860' and target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens'. Join activities to assays (on assay_id), target_dictionary (on tid), molecule_dictionary (on molregno), and compound_structures (on molregno). Return exactly two columns: molecule_dictionary.chembl_id and compound_structures.canonical_smiles, with DISTINCT applied to the result set.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4105860' AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
